comparison.title: Comparisons
comparison.subtitle: This week, month and year so far against the same span of the previous one
comparison.info: Compares the period to date with the same number of days of the previous period, so a partial week is never compared with a full one.

recent.title: Last 30 days
recent.subtitle: Pages per day with a 7-day moving average

records.title: Personal records
records.subtitle: Your best marks across the whole history

calendar.title: Reading calendar
calendar.subtitle: Last 12 months · {{pages}} pages over {{days}} active days

yoy.title: Year over year
yoy.subtitle: Pages per month, this year against last year

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.subtitle: Active days and deep reading days
consistency.info: A deep reading day has 60 minutes or more recorded.

pace.title: Reading speed
pace.subtitle: Pages per hour by month and by category
pace.info: Total pages divided by total time, using only entries that recorded a reading time.
pace.empty: Record reading times to see your speed.

projection.title: Finish projection
projection.subtitle: At the pace of the last 14 days
projection.info: Progress is the larger of the reader position and the pages you logged for the book. Books need a known page count.
projection.empty: No book with a known page count was read in the last 14 days.

profile.title: Reader profile
profile.subtitle: Last 90 days, scored from 0 to 100
profile.info: Volume: 40 pages/day = 100. Consistency: share of active days. Speed: 45 pages/h = 100. Variety: 6 different titles = 100. Depth: 60 minutes per active day = 100. Weekends: 50 = a fair share of weekend reading.

clock.title: Reading clock
clock.subtitle: Pages by time of day
clock.info: Based on the time each entry was saved. Entries are usually logged right after reading, so this approximates when you read.
clock.empty: Not enough entries with a time yet.

languages.desktopOnly: Vocabulary statistics are available in the desktop app.
languages.empty: Read a book in the Lyceum Reader's language mode to start building your vocabulary.

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtitle: Vocabulary tracked by the Lyceum Reader

curve.title: Vocabulary growth
curve.subtitle: Known words over time
curve.info: Recorded daily from now on. Days before the first record are estimated from when each word last changed state.

level.title: Estimated level
level.subtitle: By number of known lemmas
level.info: A rough CEFR estimate based on vocabulary size only (A1 500, A2 1,000, B1 2,000, B2 4,000, C1 8,000, C2 16,000 lemmas). It is not a test result.

coverage.title: Coverage by book
coverage.subtitle: Share of each book's text that you already know
coverage.info: Weighted by how often each word appears. Around 98% is comfortable reading; 90% is good for study with a dictionary. Markers show both thresholds.
coverage.empty: Open books in the Lyceum Reader's language mode to see their coverage.

byBook.title: Words saved per book
byBook.subtitle: Words and expressions saved while reading each book
byBook.empty: No words saved from books yet.

stubborn.title: Stubborn words
stubborn.subtitle: Looked up many times and still not known
stubborn.info: Words you looked up more than once that are still marked as unknown or learning.
stubborn.empty: No repeatedly looked-up words. Well done.

library.desktopOnly: Library statistics are available in the desktop app.
library.empty: Add books to your library to see its statistics.

size.title: Size and backlog
size.subtitle: What you own compared with what you read
size.info: Files marked as "not a book" are excluded. The backlog is the unread pages divided by your average pages per day over the last 90 days.

journey.title: Book journey
journey.subtitle: From the library to the last page

funnel.title: Status funnel

forgotten.pauseFailed: Could not update the book status

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.subtitle: Most common subjects in the book metadata
subjects.empty: No subjects in the book metadata yet.

authors.title: Most present authors

authors.empty: No authors in the book metadata yet.

growth.title: Library growth
growth.subtitle: Books added and finished per month (last 24 months)
growth.info: Finished books use the completion date set when a book is marked as read.

ratings.title: Your ratings

annotations.title: Recent annotations
annotations.subtitle: Key concepts and reader notes from every book

concepts.title: Concept map across books
concepts.subtitle: Key concepts and their relations; hover to highlight
concepts.info: Solid lines are relations you created. Dotted lines join concepts with the same name in different books. Colour = source book.
concepts.empty: Create key concepts while reading PDFs to build the map.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly targets
goals.info: The marker shows whether you are ahead of or behind the pace needed for each period. The yearly book goal counts books marked as read in the library.

streak.freezeAvailable: This week's rest day is still available.
